target_claim: The stated formulas define the induced action of the direct-product group Γ = Z/3Z × Z/2Z on π₁ ≅ F₂.
source_quote:
As described at the end of section~\ref{Hurwitz}, $\Gamma=\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z}\times \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}=\left<\sigma,\tau\right>$ acts harmonically on $G$, and this action induces the following action on $\pi_1$: the transposition $\tau$ acts by inversion, and
$$
\sigma(\gamma_1)=\gamma_2 \qquad \sigma(\gamma_2)=\gamma_1^{-1}\gamma_2^{-1}.
$$
